sampling_model.units: Independent superpopulation draws with \(q_{ni}\sim\mathcal N(0,I_{p_n})\) and \(p_n/n\to\kappa\).
sampling_model.treatment: Binary treatment \(A_{ni}\in\{0,1\}\) with known propensity one half.
sampling_model.outcome: Binary outcome with \(Y_{ni}\mid(q_{ni},A_{ni})\sim\operatorname{Bernoulli}\{\sigma(\gamma q_{ni,1})\}\) in both arms.
sampling_model.overlap: Known propensity is exactly one half.
sampling_model.nuisance_estimation: On each arm's certified strict-feasibility event, the unique exact same-sample entropy weights balance all \(p_n\) coordinates to the pooled empirical mean. On its complement, uniform within-arm weights provide a harmless total finite-sample default and are not called entropy balancing. Every least-squares leverage object uses the Moore--Penrose pseudoinverse for arbitrary \(Q_n\). Oracle DR uses the known conditional mean, while \(\gamma\) is estimated only for phase inference.

comparator_promise_table.comparator_claim: Theorem 4 gives \(\sqrt n(\widehat\theta^{ep}-\theta^*)\Rightarrow G\) and \(nR_\lambda(\widehat\theta^{ep})\Rightarrow G^\top HG/2\) in fixed policy dimension.
Nonparametrically estimated-propensity IPW attains the semiparametric efficiency bound for the average treatment effect.
The proportional logistic MLE has coordinate and norm limits governed by three scalar state parameters.
Logistic-MLE existence has a sharp Gaussian proportional phase-transition curve.
A convex Gaussian \(M\)-estimator has a deterministic squared-error limit obtained from a finite scalar saddle problem.
A quadratic approximate-balance constraint avoids infeasibility of high-dimensional exact balancing.
The approximate kinematic formula locates random cone-intersection transitions through statistical dimensions up to a square-root-dimensional window.
Entropy balancing has an exponential-tilt dual whose optimum enforces exact covariate moments.
Entropy balancing is doubly robust and can attain semiparametric efficiency under fixed-dimensional model conditions.
A debiased proportional regression adjustment admits a linear-plus-quadratic limit and feasible conservative inference.
Doubly robust policy scores support regret guarantees for empirical policy learning under observational sampling.

body.tldr: A binary randomized trial can use known-propensity IPW, certified exact entropy-balanced IPW with a uniform off-feasibility default, or oracle DR to learn a KL-regularized logistic assignment rule. Fixed-dimensional theory ranks sufficiently rich estimated-propensity criteria as efficient, but this ranking need not survive when the policy dimension is proportional to sample size. Population regret reduces exactly to the selected policy norm, and row-sign symmetrization makes the unconditional marginal true-IPW objective law gamma-free; this symmetry does not remove \(\gamma\) from entropy balancing, oracle DR, cross-method dependence, or the phase diagram. The core derives the pooled-target balance threshold and asks for a joint deterministic tilt-policy system on the certified balance-and-rank event that retains same-sample overlaps, Jacobian responses, nonconcave global selection, and radius saturation. Every finite-sample objective and optimizer remains total through the harmless fallback and Moore--Penrose leverage convention. The system yields positive, zero, and negative HIR-dividend cells together with a total classifier that uses a certified branch, separate feasibility, radius, collision, and zero-dividend distances, and an estimable simultaneous radius to report a sign or \(\bot\).

project_justification.gap: FangRidderXie2026 proves efficient penalized-policy regret only for a fixed finite-dimensional rule class, while proportional logistic theory and high-dimensional balancing theory study separate convex estimators. No published result jointly analyzes exact same-sample entropy tilts and the downstream global logistic-policy optimizer.
project_justification.niche: The proportional regime makes own-observation leverage, tilt-policy overlap, and tilt-Jacobian response terms order one; it also creates a sharp feasibility boundary and permits a reversal of the classical HIR regret ordering.
project_justification.fill: The project combines deformed-orthant conic geometry with a joint leave-one-out resolvent construction and a separate global-selection certificate, then maps the selected norms into exact regret and phase inference.

body.related_work: FangRidderXie2026 supplies the benchmark-lottery motivation, the fixed-dimensional regret law, and the rich-balance HIR comparison; Open-ended Question 1 targets the precise proportional gap identified in its conclusion. HiranoImbensRidder2003 supplies the classical score-projection mechanism, while Proposition 4 records why balancing only linear coordinates does not attain the full oracle projection here. SurCandes2019 reduces a single proportional logistic likelihood to scalar state evolution, and ThrampoulidisAbbasiHassibi2018 derives finite saddle systems for convex Gaussian estimators; the present pipeline is coupled and its policy objective is not globally concave. CandesSur2020 and AmelunxenLotzMcCoyTropp2014 provide the separation and statistical-dimension techniques adapted in Theorem 2 to an endogenous pooled target. Hainmueller2012 and ZhaoPercival2017 connect entropy duality, exact balance, and fixed-dimensional causal efficiency, whereas DaiYan2024 emphasizes that exact balance can fail in high dimension. LuYangWang2025 shows how order-one diagonal and off-diagonal leverage terms enter proportional randomized-trial adjustment, motivating the quadratic kill test without subsuming exponential same-sample weights. AtheyWager2021 supplies the oracle DR policy-score comparator. AshrafKarlanYin2006 supplies the commitment-savings application substrate, but the current Gaussian binary model is a calibration benchmark rather than a literal model of that three-arm trial.
body.technical_internal_limitation: The row contribution \(c\{\sigma(z)-1/2\}-\lambda h(z)\) need not be concave in \(z\), so a stationary AMP equation or a direct convex-CGMT invocation does not certify the selected policy. Row-sign symmetrization identifies only the unconditional marginal law of the true-IPW random function; conditioning on the original design or coupling that function to entropy tilts, oracle DR, or branch certificates destroys the reduction needed for the joint phase calculation. The entropy-balanced quadratic identity contains the coherent term \(\|L_nD_nu_n\|_2^2\), which cannot be dropped or evaluated by replacing \(D_n\) with independent lognormal weights. Finite computations suggest both ranking reversal and radius-induced equality, but they neither prove asymptotic cells nor exclude optimizer collisions.
body.honest_scope: The radial regret identity, unconditional marginal true-IPW gamma-invariance, deformed-orthant threshold calculation, fixed-dimensional score variances, and conditional quadratic identity are concrete derivation targets, but every numbered node remains to be proved. The true-IPW invariance is not conditional on \(Q_n\) or \(A_n\) and does not apply to entropy tilts, the \(E\) or \(D\) criteria, cross-method overlaps, branch or collision quantities, \(r_E\), \(r_D\), \(\Delta_{\mathrm{HIR}}\), or the phase vector \(\xi=(\kappa,\gamma,\lambda,R)\). The entropy weights, empirical objectives, leverage matrices, and deterministic global selectors are defined on every finite sample. The uniform arm weights used when strict feasibility fails are only a totality convention: all exact-balance identities and all asymptotic conclusions for method \(E\) are restricted to \(\mathcal E_{0n}\cap\mathcal E_{1n}\cap\mathcal Q_n\), whose probability tends to one in the claimed interior regime. The principal open content is finite closure plus global uniqueness for the original same-sample entropy tilts and nonconcave policy optimizer on that certified event. The phase rule is defined everywhere but abstains at uncertified branches and within its simultaneous uncertainty radius of feasibility, zero-dividend, radius-contact, or collision boundaries; its uniform sign-consistency and simultaneous coverage claims apply to compact interior branch strata separated from all four boundaries and from the endpoints of the signal interval. Learned outcome regression, non-Gaussian covariates, heterogeneous effects, multiple arms, and a literal analysis of savings outcomes remain outside scope.
